# Stefano Borzì

> Personal portfolio of Stefano Borzì, a freelance full-stack software engineer based in the
> Netherlands, focused on Angular and TypeScript, with a PhD in Computer Science from the University
> of Catania. He is open to new freelance roles as an Angular frontend or full-stack developer, in
> the Amsterdam area or remote. The site covers his work experience, skills, software projects,
> open-source communities, teaching, academic publications, and conference talks. He works
> primarily with TypeScript, Angular, React, Node.js, NestJS, Python, and Laravel, and is
> passionate about open source and Linux.

## About
- [About](https://stefanoborzi.dev/#about): Bio, contact, work experience, education, spoken languages and skills. Freelance full-stack engineer at Royal BAM Group, previously frontend team lead at FedEx, and Contract Professor at the University of Catania. Started programming at 12; founder of two open-source communities (AzerothCore, UNICT-DEVS). Open to new freelance roles.
- [Full Resume (PDF)](https://stefanoborzi.dev/StefanoBorzi-CV.pdf): Complete academic and industry CV.
- [Industry Resume (PDF)](https://stefanoborzi.dev/StefanoBorzi-CV-Industry.pdf): Industry-focused CV.
- Contact: stefanoborzi32@gmail.com | [GitHub @Helias](https://github.com/Helias) | [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/in/stefanoborzi) | [Telegram @Helias](https://t.me/Helias) | [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=80n8dycAAAAJ)

- Backend & APIs: Node.js, NestJS, Express.js, PHP (Laravel), Python (FastAPI, Flask), Java (Spring Boot), .NET, REST, SOAP, WebSockets, Socket.io, Microservices, C, C++, R, PyTorch, SQL (MySQL, SQLite), Bash, Lua
- Testing & QA: Cypress, Playwright, Jest, Karma, Jasmine, Pytest, Selenium, A/B Testing (Optimizely), Accessibility (WCAG)
- Infrastructure & DevOps: Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), Azure, Linux (OpenWRT, DDWRT), Firebase, Supabase, Nginx, Apache, Radius
- Tools & UI/UX: Git (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket), Nx, Webpack, Vite, Jira, Figma, Adobe Analytics, SASS, TailwindCSS, Bootstrap, Material Design, WordPress
- AI: Agentic AI (skills, rules, and tools for AI coding agents)
- Methodologies: Scrum, SAFe-Agile, Kanban, Technical Writing (LaTeX)

## Work Experience
- [Projects](https://stefanoborzi.dev/#projects): Full-stack developer with a strong focus on front-end (Angular). Selected roles:
  - Fullstack Developer (freelance), Royal BAM Group, May 2025 - Present: digitalizing construction processes (TypeScript, Angular, Node.js, NestJS, NgRx, .NET, Nx, Playwright)
  - Team Lead, FedEx, Jan 2023 - May 2025: led frontend development, releases, and hiring for an international web app
  - Senior Programmer Analyst, FedEx, Jan 2021 - Dec 2022: 33% app size reduction, Angular upgrades, performance optimization
  - Software Engineer, Infront Finance (ex VWD group), Jan 2020 - Dec 2020: FinTech platform, removed jQuery dependency
  - Software Developer (freelance), Fiverr, Aug 2018 - Jan 2020: web scrapers, Telegram bots, automation (Python, Node.js)

## Open Source
- [Opensource](https://stefanoborzi.dev/#opensource): Founder of two open-source communities.
  - [AzerothCore](https://github.com/azerothcore): Open-source MMORPG game server framework based on World of Warcraft (patch 3.3.5a)
  - [UNICT-DEVS](https://github.com/unict-dmi): Community of University of Catania DMI students building Telegram bots, web apps, and automation tools for university services
- Agentic AI projects:
  - [agent-toolkit](https://github.com/eai-org/agent-toolkit) (contributor): Minimalistic, project-agnostic skills and rules for AI coding agents
  - [ai-py-skills](https://github.com/PythonCatania/ai-py-skills): Agent skills for Python projects, from the Python Catania community
  - [ai-notify](https://github.com/Helias/ai-notify): Plays a sound when an AI coding agent finishes or needs attention while its terminal is unfocused

## Teaching
- [Teachings](https://stefanoborzi.dev/#teachings): Contract Professor at the University of Catania, Department of Mathematics and Computer Science.
- "Software Quality and Project Development", master's course (academic year 2026/2027). Covers UNIX shell, Git/GitHub workflows, open-source engagement, Python, unit and end-to-end testing with Playwright, Docker, code quality (SOLID), CI/CD, and agentic coding with AI assistants.
  - [Course page](https://web.dmi.unict.it/courses/lm-18/course-units?aa=127&ins=9799487) | [Course GitHub Organization](https://github.com/UNICT-Quality-Development/) | [Telegram](https://t.me/unict_sqpd)
- "Quality Development", bachelor's course (academic years 2021/2022, 2022/2023, 2023/2024 and 2025/2026). Covers UNIX shell, Git/GitHub workflows, open-source engagement, Python, unit testing, code quality (SOLID), and CI/CD.
  - [Course GitHub Organization](https://github.com/UNICT-Quality-Development/) | [Slides](https://unict-quality-development.github.io/QualityDevelopment-slides/) | [Students Projects](https://unict-quality-development.github.io/git-catalogue/) | [Telegram](https://t.me/unict_qd)

## Publications
- [Publications](https://stefanoborzi.dev/#publications): Research focused on synthetic/deepfake audio detection and audio processing.
  - [Breaking the Silence: Detecting AI-Converted Voices in the Quietest Moments](https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-031-88223-4_14): Deepfake audio detection using handcrafted features and Random Forest on silent audio segments
  - [Is synthetic voice detection research going into the right direction?](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2022W/WMF/papers/Borzi_Is_Synthetic_Voice_Detection_Research_Going_Into_the_Right_Direction_CVPRW_2022_paper.pdf): CVPR 2022 workshop paper critiquing voice spoofing datasets
  - [Spafe: Simplified Python Audio Features Extraction](https://zenodo.org/records/11396240): Lightweight Python audio feature extraction library
  - [NETME: on-the-fly knowledge network construction from biomedical literature](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s41109-021-00435-x): System for extracting biological knowledge networks from PubMed texts
  - [SMART: The String Matching Algorithms Research Tool](https://www.stringology.org/papers/PSC2016.pdf#page=109): Tool and survey for testing exact string matching algorithms

## Events & Talks

Topics include Python multithreading, extensibility, and AI agent skills (PythonCatania), GitHub & CI/CD for code security, audio processing with ffmpeg, synthetic voice detection (MediaForensics 2022), history of operating systems, and open data manipulation (OpenDataSicilia 2022).
